pretreatment: For Ge(100): (1) 10 min boiling in trichloroethylene; (2) 30 s rinsing in a HC1:H2O2:H2O (1:1:30) solution; (3) 30 s rinsing in a NH3OH:H2O2:H2O (1:1:30) solution; (4) rinsing in de-ionized water. For Si(100): (1) 10 mm boiling in a H2SO4:H2O2 (1:3) solution; (2) 45 s rinsing in a HF:H2O2:H2O (1:1:10) solution; (3) 10 min rinsing in a NH4OH:H2O2:H2O (1:1:10) solution (80 “C); and (4) rinsing in de-ionized water.
evidence: For Ge(100): (1) 10 min boiling in trichloroethylene; (2) 30 s rinsing in a HC1:H2O2:H2O (1:1:30) solution; (3) 30 s rinsing in a NH3OH:H2O2:H2O (1:1:30) solution; (4) rinsing in de-ionized water. For Si(100): (1) 10 mm boiling in a H2SO4:H2O2 (1:3) solution; (2) 45 s rinsing in a HF:H2O2:H2O (1:1:10) solution; (3) 10 min rinsing in a NH4OH:H2O2:H2O (1:1:10) solution (80 “C); and (4) rinsing in de-ionized water.
